subtitle.en: Sign in to keep their sizes, favourites and orders.
subtitle.ar: سجّل الدخول لتحفظ مقاساتهم ومفضّلتهم وطلباتك.
subtitle.tr: Bedenlerini, favorilerini ve siparişlerinizi saklamak için giriş yapın.

children.text: Choose an age and we'll set out a little world of pieces.

ar.text: اختر العمر ونرتّب لك عالمًا صغيرًا من القطع.

tr.text: Bir yaş seçin, size küçük bir parça dünyası hazırlayalım.

children.name: A newborn gift can be wrapped, with your card written by hand.

children.text: A newborn gift can be wrapped, with your card written by hand.

ar.text: يمكن تغليف هدية المولود مع بطاقتك مكتوبة باليد.

tr.text: Yenidoğan hediyesi elle yazılmış kartınızla paketlenebilir.

children.text: Sizes, gifts and deliveries: we answer every message.

ar.text: المقاسات والهدايا والتوصيل: نردّ على كل رسالة.

tr.text: Beden, hediye ve teslimat: her mesajı yanıtlıyoruz.

children.text: Pick their age and I'll check it fits!

ar.text: اختر عمر طفلك وسأتأكّد أن المقاس يناسبه!

tr.text: Yaşını seç, bedenin uyduğuna ben bakarım!

entries.title: Packed
entries.text: Folded, checked and packed with care, the gifts wrapped.

ar.title: تم التغليف
ar.text: طُوي وفُحص وغُلّف بعناية، والهدايا مغلّفة.

tr.title: Paketlendi
tr.text: Katlandı, kontrol edildi, özenle paketlendi; hediyeler sarıldı.

entries.title: On its way
entries.text: With the courier, on its way to you.

entries.title: Delivered
entries.text: Enjoy it. A size that doesn't fit is easy to exchange from your orders.

ar.title: تم التوصيل
ar.text: استمتعي به. استبدال المقاس غير المناسب سهل من طلباتكِ.

tr.title: Teslim edildi
tr.text: Güle güle kullanın. Uymayan bedeni siparişlerinizden kolayca değiştirin.
